title: CIAER+ Event Schema
description: CIAER+ decision event schema v1.0. Extends the five-phase Cause-Intuition-Action-Effect-Result framework with a pre-cause environmental layer (pre_env) and Shadow Actions as a first-class structured field. This schema is the single source of truth: Kotlin data classes (Android capture side) and Python dataclasses (corpus server side) are both generated from this file.

event_id.description: Globally unique UUIDv4. Immutable once assigned.

schema_version.description: Schema version tag. Pinned so downstream consumers can detect future migrations.

shadow_actions.description: First-class structured field. Actions the operator considered and consciously rejected. Empty array for SKILL-level events where no alternatives were consciously considered. Populated by explicit elicitation during or after the Action phase.

parent_event_id.description: Optional. Set if this event is a child micro-CIAER cycle nested within a parent Action phase. Supports hierarchical nesting per §3.5.

PreEnv.description: Pre-cause environmental layer. Continuous ambient context attached to every event by reference at Cause firing. Not a phase in the state machine; sampled from background trackers.

snapshot_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this PreEnv snapshot was assembled. Typically within milliseconds of cause.capture_timestamp.

operator_id.description: Stable operator identifier, captured once at shift login and inherited by all events this shift.

shift_phase.description: Derived from shift start time and system clock by ShiftPhaseDetector.

shift_session_id.description: Identifier for the operator's shift session. All events from one shift share one session_id.

material_batch_id.description: Current material batch identifier. Captured at batch changeover via BatchChangeScreen (barcode scan or short-code entry). Null if no batch has been recorded yet this shift.

material_batch_started_at.description: Timestamp the current batch was reported starting. Used to compute time-on-batch for analysis.

ambient_temp_f.description: Ambient temperature in Fahrenheit. Best-available proxy for shop-floor thermal conditions. For Gen 1 this is outdoor temperature from a weather API; the source is recorded in ambient_temp_source for downstream analysis of thermal confound strength.

ambient_temp_source.description: How ambient_temp_f was obtained. weather_api = outdoor proxy, sensor = on-floor sensor, manual = operator-entered, unavailable = field could not be populated.

recent_events_summary.description: Short natural-language summary of recent events this shift. Generated by RecentEventsRollup from the last N events in the corpus. Provides the event with its operational history context.

Cause.description: The interface event. A registered discrepancy between the operator's internal model and the actual environmental state.

capture_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of Cause firing.

trigger_source.description: Which channel fired the capture. multimodal = convergent deviation across two or more channels (the default architecture per §5.4).

trigger_channels.description: Specific channels that registered convergent deviation within the calibration window.

sensor_readings.description: Instrument readings captured at Cause moment. Populated by GaugeReader from camera frame + multimodal LLM.

gaze_dwell_duration_sec.description: Duration of sustained visual engagement with the causative element before capture fired.

visual_anchor_description.description: Natural-language description of the visual element that drew gaze. May be LLM-generated from the Cause-moment camera frame.

visual_anchor_frame_ref.description: Storage reference (local path or server URI) to the camera frame captured at Cause. Frames are stored separately from events; this is a pointer.

acoustic_profile.description: Optional acoustic fingerprint or descriptor if acoustic channel fired.

Intuition.description: Inference and projection. The operator's causal model at the moment of decision.

srk_level.description: Rasmussen SRK classification. SKILL = automatic pattern response, no conscious deliberation. RULE = stored experiential rule match. KNOWLEDGE = novel situation requiring deliberate analysis. Gates shadow_action elicitation intensity.

srk_confidence.description: Operator's confidence in the SRK classification, 0.0-1.0. Low values indicate boundary cases between modes — high-value capture targets.

causal_hypothesis.description: Structured one-sentence statement of the operator's active causal model: what they believe is the root cause.

failure_mode_tag.description: Domain vocabulary tag for the failure mode being diagnosed. Enables cross-event clustering by failure mode. Drawn from the controlled failure_mode vocabulary maintained in the facility's domain ontology.

projection.description: Operator's projection of what will happen if no intervention is made, and over what timeframe. Captures Endsley Level 3 Situation Awareness.

confidence_level.description: Operator's confidence in causal_hypothesis, 0.0-1.0. Weights this event's contribution to the knowledge graph.

voice_transcript.description: Raw speech-to-text transcript of operator voice annotation during Intuition phase. Unedited. Primary qualitative data source for Intuition.

precedent_event_ids.description: Event IDs the operator explicitly references as the basis for this diagnosis. Links experiential memory explicitly into the graph.

knowledge_source.description: Provenance of this causal model. Distinguishes transferred knowledge from independently developed expertise.

Action.description: Outward arc execution. The intervention taken.

action_type.description: Domain vocabulary tag for the intervention type. Drawn from the facility's action_type controlled vocabulary.

action_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of action initiation.

action_rationale.description: Brief operator-articulated rationale for this action, distinct from the causal_hypothesis above. What the action is expected to achieve.

action_sequence.description: Ordered sequence of steps within the action. A single-step action has one entry; complex interventions may have several.

was_deliberate_non_action.description: True if the operator consciously chose not to intervene. Non-action is a valid action.

parameter_changed.description: Parameter name if this step changed a machine parameter.

from_value.description: Previous value. Type depends on parameter.

to_value.description: New value. Type depends on parameter.

rationale.description: Optional per-step rationale if distinct from the overall action_rationale.

ShadowAction.description: An action the operator considered and consciously rejected. First-class structured field per CIAER+ v1. The negative space of expert decision-making.

action_type.description: Domain vocabulary tag for the rejected intervention, drawn from the same controlled vocabulary as Action.action_type.

rejection_rationale.description: Operator's reason for rejecting this alternative. Required — a shadow action without rationale carries no information.

confidence_in_rejection.description: How confident the operator is that rejecting this alternative was correct, 0.0-1.0.

Effect.description: Prediction test. The environmental state generated by the intervention.

deltas.description: Per-instrument deltas computed against Cause.sensor_readings baseline.

prediction_match.description: Whether Effect matched the operator's projection in Intuition.projection.

Result.description: Model update and loop closure. Did the outcome confirm the operator's prediction?

escalation_delta.description: Whether the situation de-escalated, escalated, or was unchanged after intervention. Narrative form.

hypothesis_confirmed.description: Did the Effect confirm the operator's causal_hypothesis in Intuition?

product_quality_impact.description: Downstream product quality impact if measurable. May be populated retrospectively when QC data becomes available.

graph_weight.description: System's confidence in this reconciliation chain as a reliable pattern, 0.0-1.0. Updated by subsequent evidence and by withhold-sampling counterfactuals (see whitepaper §10.12). Initial value assigned at event completion; mutated by training pipeline over time.

withhold_sample.description: True if this event was captured during a withhold-sampling window in which the Twin deliberately did not offer guidance. Flags the event as a counterfactual sample for the reflexivity-detection pipeline.

instrument_id.description: Stable identifier for this instrument in the facility ontology.

value.description: Reading value. Type depends on instrument.

confidence.description: Confidence in the reading. For manual or vision-based readings, this reflects extraction confidence; for networked instruments it is typically 1.0.

BiometricSnapshot.description: Point-in-time biometric state. Aligned to v10.1 HRV-centric capture: HR and HRV-RMSSD are the primary operational channels; body_response is a corroborating signal; cEDA is reserved for the Empatica validation sub-study.

hr_deviation_z.description: HR z-score relative to operator's rolling personal baseline.

hrv_deviation_z.description: HRV-RMSSD z-score relative to operator's rolling personal baseline. Negative values indicate suppression (arousal).

activity_class.description: Accelerometer-derived activity classification at capture moment. Gates trigger eligibility — see §5.4.

body_response_fired.description: True if a Fitbit Body Response notification fired within the calibration window.

eda_microsiemens.description: Raw EDA in microsiemens. Populated only when biometric source is a research-grade device such as Empatica EmbracePlus. Null for Pixel Watch deployments per §5.2.

CaptureDevice.description: Metadata about which capture source produced this event. Populated automatically from the active CaptureSource implementation.
